# Kagin

> Source-available app license-key platform on Cloudflare. Issue keys, bind devices or floating seats, verify with heartbeats and Ed25519 feature tokens. Hosted SaaS or self-host the same code.

## Primary Links

- [Homepage](https://kagin.dev/en): Product overview and console entry
- [Pricing](https://kagin.dev/en/pricing): Hosted $5/month (5 products) or self-host
- [Docs — Quick start](https://kagin.dev/en/docs/quickstart): Create a product and issue a key
- [Docs — Licensing](https://kagin.dev/en/docs/licensing): Device bind, seats, states
- [Docs — API](https://kagin.dev/en/docs/api): Public `/v1` and admin `/admin/v1`
- [Docs — SDK](https://kagin.dev/en/docs/sdk): TypeScript client
- [Docs — Deploy](https://kagin.dev/en/docs/deploy): Self-host on Cloudflare
- [GitHub](https://github.com/Go7hic/Kagin): Source repository
- [Full knowledge file](https://kagin.dev/llms-full.txt): Longer factual summary
- [Product Markdown](https://kagin.dev/product.md): Cite-ready product page

## What It Is

Kagin manages the license-key lifecycle for desktop and mobile apps: products, issuance, device activation/deactivation, concurrent seats, signed feature tokens, policies, and an admin console. Runtime is Cloudflare Workers, D1, KV, and Durable Objects.

## Who It Is For

Indie and small teams who sell apps and need enforceable device or seat limits without building a licensing backend from scratch. Commercial hosted use is $5/month; noncommercial self-host uses PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0.
